name: Tanglin Club
summary: Historic membership club with dining rooms, sport, and a formal social calendar — scarcity and proposers matter as much as facilities.
body: Tanglin Club leans heritage and social tradition — different energy from newer lifestyle clubs or the denser casual F&B scene at American Club. Peer forums frequently describe multi-year waits and proposer requirements; money alone is not always enough. Tour for culture fit as carefully as facilities: dining-room cadence, sport you will use, and whether your household actually wants a formal club calendar. Geography suits Tanglin-side lives differently than Claymore. Compare waitlist reality and monthly use maths against American Club and Hollandse Club before chasing proposers.
membershipNotes: Typically requires proposers; confirm current categories, waitlists, and guest rules with the membership office — peer wait estimates vary widely.
